Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask. I can get a concise package together. Quick notes:

- Ephemeral caching: our default inference runtime keeps KV cache in-memory per request/connection and flushes on stream close. We do not persist per-user KV to disk in hosted mode. Dedicated/private deployments can be configured with short TTLs or disabled.
- Field-level encryption: we support customer-provided client-side encryption with envelope keys; patterned examples exist where token indices are hashed for routing without exposing plaintext.
- Transit: we have per-region egress rules and can provide an exported dataflow PNG plus the KMS custody CSV.

Looping Mina (Privacy Ops) and Rishi (Security) to pull the artifacts and confirm wording for the annex.
